name: Universitetskiye rasskazy
source:
The story takes place in a modern setting, Moscow, where the familiar (and new) characters are studying.
Semyon loves Slavya, but she doesn't return his feelings.
Yet Moscow is big, and there are a lot of girls out there.
It's not for nothing that Yesenin wrote: "We all loved in those years, but it means, then, that others loved us in return"...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2291242903]Steam[/url]]
